item.title: About DefectDojo
item.description: DefectDojo, Inc. and open-source contributors maintain this documentation to support both the Community and Pro editions of DefectDojo.

item.title: Feature comparison
item.description:
DefectDojo comes in two editions, built on the same data model and the same parsers.

DefectDojo Open-Source is a free, self-hosted vulnerability management platform. It imports results from hundreds of security tools, deduplicates them, tracks every Finding through triage and remediation, and reports on the result. It suits teams that want to run and extend the platform themselves.

item.title: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions
item.description: Answers to common questions about DefectDojo Open-Source and DefectDojo Pro. Where the two editions answer a question differently, both answers are shown side by side.

item.title: 🎨 Pro UI Changes
item.description: DefectDojo Pro has its own user interface, built in Vue.js and separate from the open-source UI. It is the only interface in Pro: the Classic UI that earlier releases offered alongside it has been retired.

item.title: Online Demo
item.description: Two online demos are available for DefectDojo. Both come pre-loaded with data and are fully functional, running the latest version of DefectDojo.
